original: リタからの依頼、あなたが受けてくれるのね
traducao: You'll take on Rita's request, then.

original: ええと、今回の目的地はブラウニー坑道。\n塩水晶の採取よ
traducao: Let's see, your goal is Brownie Mine.\nTo gather Salt Crystals.

original: 同行者は、しいなとカイル君
traducao: Sheena and Kyle will go with you.

original: でも、そんな素材で\n本当にラザリスを封印出来るのかしら…
traducao: Still, could such materials really\nseal Lazaris away, I wonder...?

original: そう。\nそれじゃあ、わたしは\nあなたを信じる事にするね
traducao: I see.\nWell then, I will choose to place\nmy faith in you.

original: そうね、代案を出せって言われたって、\n他に手掛かりすらないんだものね…
traducao: True, even if we were asked for\nan alternative, we have no other clues...

original: やれる事からやりましょう。\n後悔だけはしない様に
traducao: Let's do what we can first.\nSo that we have no regrets.

original: それじゃ、行ってらっしゃい
traducao: Well then, have a safe trip!

original: 自分はニアタを信じる、と言う
traducao: Say you believe in Niata

original: 他に方法があるのか、と問う
traducao: Ask if there is another way

original: えっと…、ラザリスを封印するのに\n何が必要なんだっけ？
traducao: Um... what did we need again\nto seal Lazaris?

original: 今から取りに行く、塩水晶。\nそれから、羽があって飛び回る実と\n全身から汗を流すパン、だとさ
traducao: The Salt Crystals we're after now.\nPlus a winged fruit that flits about,\nand bread sweating all over, they say.

original: 全身から汗を流すパン！？\nそんなものどうやって作ればいいんだ？
traducao: Bread sweating all over?!\nHow are we even supposed to bake that?!

original: 本当にパンかどうかはわからないよ。\nジュディスがそういうイメージで捉えただけさ
traducao: We don't know if it's really bread.\nJudith only perceived that kind of image.

original: 残り二つがどういうものかってのは、\n船にいるみんなが調べてくれてるよ
traducao: As for what the other two are,\neveryone on the ship is looking into it.

original: 良かった〜。\nさすがにそんなパンは、\n食べる気にならないもんな
traducao: Whew, thank goodness!\nI really wouldn't feel like eating\nbread like that, after all.

original: そこは心配するトコじゃないだろ…
traducao: That's not what you should worry about...

original: この扉、開かないよ
traducao: This door won't open.

original: こいつはちょっと、仕掛けがあるんだよ
traducao: There's a trick to this one.

original: ほら、開いただろ
traducao: See? It opened.

original: うわぁ、セコい仕掛け…
traducao: Whoa, what a cheap trick...

original: カイル。\nあんた、あたし達の世界には慣れたかい？
traducao: Kyle.\nHave you gotten used to our world yet?

original: うん！\n見た事無い術とかあるし、面白いよ
traducao: Yeah!\nThere are artes I've never seen; it's fun!

original: 全く、本当に面白いよ。\nヴェラトローパの話は聞いたかい？
traducao: Indeed, it really is interesting.\nDid you hear about Veratropa?

original: あたしの故郷に伝わる光気丹術は、\nソウルアルケミーの一端だったって\n言ってたろ？
traducao: You heard that the Light Alchemy\npassed down in my homeland was just\na facet of Soul Alchemy, right?

original: その術は、遥か昔からあった\nヴェラトローパの民が\n使用してたってんだよ
traducao: That art was used by the people\nof Veratropa from the distant past,\nthey say.

original: すごいと思わないかい？\nそんなに長い間伝わってきたなんてさ
traducao: Don't you think that's amazing?\nTo be passed down for so long, I mean.

original: 何でも創り出せる力だったんでしょ？\nいつの頃から、ヒトはその力を失ったんだろう
traducao: It was a power to create anything, right?\nWhen did humans end up losing that power?

original: さあね。\nだけど、ほんの一部は残ってるじゃないか。\nあたしらが知ってる魔術って形でさ
traducao: Who knows?\nYet a small part of it still remains,\nin the form of magic that we know.

original: え？　魔術もソウルアルケミー？
traducao: Huh? Magic is Soul Alchemy too?

original: そう。\nドクメントの創造なんて事は、普通の人には\nおいそれと出来やしないけど
traducao: Right.\nCreating Documents isn't something\nordinary folks can just pull off, though.

original: まあ、ちょっとだけ使えてるってのが\n今あたし達の間で知られてる魔術だね
traducao: Well, using just a tiny bit of it\nis the magic known among us today.

original: 魔術が使えるってだけでも\nすごいと思うけどなぁ…
traducao: Just being able to use magic\nseems amazing enough to me, though...

original: 真のソウルアルケミーの使い手が\nいるとしたら…、魔術を使うにしても\n詠唱も道具も要らないだろうって言われてるよ
traducao: If a true Soul Alchemy wielder exists...\nthey say they'd need neither chanting\nnor tools, even when using magic.

original: 願えば何でも現実になるんだから
traducao: Whatever they wish for becomes reality.

original: ふぅん、やっぱ神様みたいだなぁ。\nオレ達ヒトには出来ない事だよね
traducao: Hmm, sounds just like a god.\nIt's something we humans could never do.

original: 何でも出来ちゃあ面白くないし、\nそれで生きてるって実感が\n沸くもんかねえ？
traducao: If you can do anything, it's no fun.\nCould anyone truly feel alive that way,\nI wonder?

original: ヴェラトローパの民…ヒトの祖は、\n苦難に満ちたものであっても、その力を捨てて、\n生きる事を学ぶと決めたとかって話だし
traducao: The people of Veratropa... the Progenitor\nof Man, cast off that power and chose\nto learn what it means to live.

original: そっか。\nそれで今、オレ達は生きてる事の喜びや辛さを\n知る事が出来てるんだね
traducao: I see.\nThat's why we're able to know\nthe joys and hardships of living today.

original: あたしは、その力を捨てた\nヒトの祖の子孫である事を\n誇りに思うよ
traducao: I am proud to be a descendant\nof that Progenitor of Man who cast\nthat power aside.

original: 辛かった日々も、楽しかった日々も\nあたしには宝物だからね
traducao: The painful days and the happy days\nare both precious treasures to me.

original: 誰かいるよ！
traducao: Someone's here!

original: あっ！\nあいつは、バルバトス…！！
traducao: Ah!\nThat's Barbatos...!!

original: ええ！？
traducao: What?!

original: まさか、あいつが「強い者がいると聞けば、\n戦いを挑むというめちゃくちゃな奴」かい！？
traducao: Don't tell me he's that lunatic who\nchallenges anyone strong he hears of?!

original: あいつも、一緒にこの世界へ\n飛ばされて来てたのか…
traducao: So he was flung into this world\nalong with the rest of us...

original: ほう…、死に損ないが。\nまだ生きていたのか
traducao: Hoh... you wretched survivor.\nYou're still breathing, are you?

original: 妙な所へ飛ばされたせいで、\n我が餓えを満たす相手がいなくてなぁ…
traducao: Flung into this strange place, I lacked\nfoes to satisfy my eternal hunger...

original: 望むところだ、バルバトス！\nお前なんかに父さんを殺させやしない！
traducao: Just what I wanted, Barbatos!\nI won't let the likes of you kill my dad!

original: カイル、待ちなって！\n勝てる相手なのかい？
traducao: Kyle, hold on!\nIs he someone you can actually beat?!

original: 心配するな。\nその答えは一つしかない
traducao: Do not fret.\nThere is but a single answer to that.

original: 貴様達はここで骸になるだけだ
traducao: You will merely become corpses right here.

original: 逃げられるとは思うなよ。\nさあ、来い！！
traducao: Do not think you can flee.\nNow, come at me!!

original: ちょこざいな……。\nだが、今度は帰れぬぞ
traducao: Insolent fools...\nYet this time, you shall not return!

original: その身、ここで塵にしてくれるわ！！
traducao: I shall reduce your bodies to dust here!!

original: ぐぉぉぉぉ……ッ
traducao: Gwoooooh...!

original: し、仕留めた…！？
traducao: D-Did we finish him...?!

original: クク、ククク…
traducao: Heh, hehehe...

original: いいぞ…
traducao: Splendid...

original: いいぞ、いいぞ、いいぞ！！
traducao: Splendid, splendid, SPLENDID!!

original: 貴様だ！\n貴様が俺の渇きをいやす者！
traducao: It is you!\nYou are the one to quench my thirst!

original: 覚えたぞ、貴様の顔。\n次に相見える時は血祭りにあげてやる
traducao: I have memorized your face.\nNext time we meet, I'll slaughter you!

original: それまで首をよーく洗っておくんだな
traducao: Wash your neck well until then!

original: ククク…
traducao: Kukuku...

original: ハァーッハッハッハッハ！
traducao: Bwahahahaha!

original: とどめを、刺せなかった…
traducao: We couldn't... finish him off...

original: でも、あいつを倒さないと\n父さんが！！
traducao: Still, if we don't defeat him,\nmy dad will be--!!

original: あいつ、前に会った時より\n強くなってた…
traducao: He was stronger than the last time\nwe crossed paths...

original: きっとまた、次に会う時は…
traducao: Next time we meet, he'll surely be...

original: 全く、熱くなり過ぎだよ。\nあんなに見境なく突っ込んでたら、\n命がいくらあっても足りないね
traducao: Honestly, you got far too reckless.\nCharging in so blindly, no amount of lives\nwould be enough!

original: ごめん。\nオレ、みんなの事を考えて無かった…
traducao: I'm sorry.\nI wasn't thinking of the rest of you...

original: 巻き込んで、ごめん…
traducao: I'm sorry for dragging you into this...

original: 巻き込まれたって事は構わないさ。\nあんたの父親を守りたいって気持ちもわかるし、\nそれに協力はしてあげたいしね
traducao: I don't mind being dragged into it.\nI understand wanting to protect your dad,\nand I want to help you with that.

original: ただ、何でも闇雲に行くのはよしなって事さ
traducao: Just don't rush blindly into things.

original: う、うん…
traducao: Y-Yeah...

original: よし、じゃあこの話は終わりだ
traducao: Alright, that's enough of this.

original: さてと…
traducao: Now then...

original: 無謀にも挑んだカイルを咎める
traducao: Scold Kyle for recklessly challenging him

original: 溜息を吐く
traducao: Sigh

original: ふぅ…、用があったのは\nあのバルバトスって奴じゃなくて\nこいつだったのにね
traducao: Phew... the one we had business with\nwasn't that Barbatos fellow,\nit was this thing here.

original: それが塩水晶？
traducao: Is that the Salt Crystal?

original: そうさ。\nこれで依頼は達成
traducao: That's right.\nWith this, the request is fulfilled.

original: さあ、船に戻るよ
traducao: Come on, let's get back to the ship.

original: ご苦労様。\n今回は大変だったね。\n恐い人に目を付けられちゃって…
traducao: Welcome back.\nIt was tough this time, wasn't it?\nCatching the eye of such a scary man...

original: 各国も大変な状況みたい。\nジルディアのキバが現れたせいで\nどこも大騒ぎよ
traducao: The nations seem in turmoil as well.\nDue to the Fang of Zirdia's emergence,\neverywhere is in utter uproar.

original: 以前紛争が起きていた場所も、\n今は停戦となって、\n人々は結束し始めている様ですわ
traducao: Even places where conflict once raged\nhave entered ceasefires, and people\nseem to be uniting together.

original: あのキバの出現を目の当たりにする事で、\n争っている場合ではない、\nと気が付いてくれたのでしょう
traducao: Witnessing the emergence of that Fang,\nthey must have realized it is no time\nfor petty squabbling.

original: ですが…、この様な危機を迎える事でしか、\n人々は手を取り合う事が出来ないので\nしょうか…？
traducao: Yet... is facing such a dire crisis\nthe only way people can bring themselves\nto join hands together...?

original: そうね。\nでも、そんなに悲観的にならないで
traducao: Indeed.\nStill, please don't be so pessimistic.

original: 手を取り合える事を「知る」その一歩が\n大事なんだから
traducao: Learning that we can take each other's\nhands is the vital first step.

original: そうですわね
traducao: That is true.

original: 一方、その頃
traducao: Meanwhile, around that time...

original: 生き物のフリをしてるだけだ。\nまだ不完全で、まともに動く事も出来ないか
traducao: Merely pretending to be alive.\nStill incomplete, unable to even move...

original: くっ…、\n僕の作りたかったのは\nこんなものじゃない
traducao: Kh...\nWhat I wanted to create\nwasn't something like this!

original: …いや、不完全なのは僕も同じか
traducao: ...No, I am just as incomplete, aren't I?

original: ルミナシアの民から得た醜い身体…。\n僕にもっと力があれば、\nこんな姿は捨てられるのに…
traducao: A hideous body taken from Luminasia...\nIf only I possessed greater power,\nI could discard this form...

original: ごめんよ。\n生まれてきてくれたんだよね。\nごめん…
traducao: I'm sorry.\nYou were born for me, weren't you?\nI'm sorry...

original: 生きよう。\n一緒に生きようね…
traducao: Let us live.\nLet us live together, alright...?

original: やっぱり、世界樹を…。\n生命の場を手に入れるまでは\n世界を奪い尽くせないのか…
traducao: In the end, until I claim the World Tree\nand the Field of Life...\nI cannot rob this world completely...?

original: アンジュ、封印次元を作る為の\n残り二つが判明した
traducao: Ange, the remaining two components\nto forge the Sealing Dimension are known.

original: ホント？
traducao: Really?

original: 羽があって飛び回る実…、\nこれはツリガネトンボ草の事だ
traducao: A fruit with wings that flies around...\nThis refers to the Bell Dragonfly Herb.

original: もう一つ、全身から汗を流すパンというのは、\n多孔菌の一種、ウズマキフスベというキノコだ
traducao: The sweating bread is a polypore fungus,\na mushroom called the Whirl Puffball.

original: じゃあ、それらを採取しに行けば\nいいんですね
traducao: Then we just need to go\nand gather them, correct?

original: いや、それがそうは行かないんだ…
traducao: No, it won't be that simple...

original: 危険な場所へ行かなければならないの？
traducao: Must we go to a dangerous place?

original: いや、その二つはもうこの世に\n存在しない
traducao: No, those two no longer exist\nin this world.

original: 既に絶滅したものなんだ
traducao: They have already gone extinct.

original: 絶滅？
traducao: Extinct?

original: そんな…。\nそれじゃもう、手に入らないんですか…？
traducao: No way...\nThen can we never obtain them...?

original: ウィルさん、その二つは\nどうやって調べたのですか？
traducao: Mr. Raynard, how did you manage\nto identify those two?

original: その事なんだが…
traducao: About that...

original: 実は、二つともカノンノが描いた風景の中に\nあってな
traducao: Actually, both of them appeared\nwithin landscapes Kanonno sketched.

original: ジュディスがそれを見て、\nプレートで伝えられた情報と同じものだと\n教えてくれたわけだ
traducao: Judith saw them and told us\nthey matched the information inscribed\non the stone plate.

original: それを元に調べた結果、この二つのものの\n正体がわかったのだが…
traducao: Investigating based on that,\nwe uncovered their true identities, but...

original: ○○。\nカノンノの所へ行ってくれるか？
traducao: ○○.\nCould you go see Kanonno?

original: この事で、彼女も動揺してる様だ
traducao: She seems quite shaken by this.

original: カノンノの所へ行くのか？
traducao: You're going to see Kanonno?

original: ああ、そうしてくれ。\n今回の件で、彼女も動揺している様だからな
traducao: Yes, please.\nShe seems shaken by this revelation.

original: そういえば、少しカノンノの\n様子がおかしかったわね…
traducao: Come to think of it, Kanonno seemed\na little unusual earlier...

original: ○○。\nわたしからもお願い。\nカノンノの所へ行ってあげて
traducao: ○○.\nPlease, I ask of you as well.\nGo see how Kanonno is doing.

original: カノンノの事を気にする
traducao: Worry about Kanonno

original: カノンノの所へ行く
traducao: Go to see Kanonno

original: あ、○○…。\nあなただったんだ…
traducao: Ah, ○○...\nIt was you...

original: ん、ありがとう。\nちょっと、自分の絵の事で\n色々考えちゃって…
traducao: Mm, thank you.\nI was just thinking about lots of things\nregarding my paintings...

original: そうなの？
traducao: Is that so?

original: ふふ、嬉しいな
traducao: Fufu, that makes me happy.

original: ヴェラトローパの他にも、あったんだ
traducao: There was more besides Veratropa, too.

original: ジュディスさんが私の絵を見て、\nこれから探さなくちゃいけない二つのものが\n絵の中にあったって
traducao: Judith saw my paintings and told me\nthe two things we need to search for\nwere right there in the drawings.

original: 何で、私には知らない風景が\n見えてるんだろう。\n何の為に見えてるんだろう
traducao: Why am I able to see landscapes\nthat I know nothing about?\nAnd for what purpose can I see them?

original: 私って、一体何なのかな…って\nちょっと考えてた
traducao: I was just thinking to myself...\nwhat in the world am I?

original: それよりも、ね。\nあなたも何だか\n思い詰めた様な顔をしてる
traducao: More importantly, though...\nYou also look troubled somehow,\nlike something's on your mind.

original: 気になる事でもあるの？\n良かったら…、聞かせて欲しいな
traducao: Is there something bothering you?\nIf you'd like... please tell me.

original: ラザリスの事…？
traducao: About Lazaris...?

original: …放っておけば朽ちるはずだった、\nラザリスの世界、ジルディア…。\nそれを私達の世界、ルミナシアが取り込んだ…
traducao: ...Lazaris's world, Zirdia,\ndestined to rot if left alone...\nOur world, Luminasia, absorbed it...

original: なぜ、世界樹が\nジルディアを取り込んだんだろう、って？
traducao: Why did the World Tree\nabsorb Zirdia, you ask?

original: そう…だね
traducao: Yeah... that's right.

original: ルミナシアにとって、\n災厄となるかもしれないのに、世界樹は\nわざわざ取り込んで、封印したんだよね
traducao: Even though it might become a calamity\nfor Luminasia, the World Tree went out\nof its way to absorb and seal it.

original: その、世界樹の意志は…私にはわからない。\nでも…。\n世界樹には、何か考えがあったのかなぁ…
traducao: I don't understand the Tree's will...\nStill...\nDid the World Tree have something in mind?

original: うん。\n世界樹の本当の気持ち。\n私も知りたいな…
traducao: Yeah.\nThe World Tree's true feelings.\nI want to know them too...

original: ごめん…、何も力になれなくて…
traducao: I'm sorry... I couldn't be of any help...

original: …あの、ね
その…、話を聞かせてもらっておきながら\n何にも力になれなかったけど。\n…その、何て言えばいいのかな
traducao: I asked to hear your thoughts,\nyet I couldn't help you at all, but...\n...Um, how should I put it?

original: 一人で抱え込まないで。\nみんないるから。\n私も、みんなもいるから
traducao: Don't carry it all alone.\nEveryone is here for you.\nI am here, and everyone else is too.
...Okay?

original: 様子が気になった、と言う
traducao: Say you were concerned about her

original: ただ、何となく来てみた、と言う
traducao: Say you just happened to drop by

original: 話す
traducao: Tell her

original: 言いにくそうに話す
traducao: Speak with hesitation

original: 真相が知りたい、と言う
traducao: Say you want to know the truth

original: 何も知らない事に落ち込む
traducao: Despondently say you know nothing

original: そうだわ、○○。\nあなたに話があるの
traducao: Oh right, ○○.\nThere's something I wish to discuss.

original: 甲板で待っているわね
traducao: I'll be waiting on the deck.

original: 話がしたかったの。\nあなたと
traducao: I wanted to talk.\nWith you.

original: 故郷とディセンダーの為に肉体を捨て、\n機械に宿った異世界の賢人達
traducao: Otherworld sages who dwelt in machines,\ncasting off flesh for their Descender...

original: ニアタの欠片よ。\nあの時、持って帰ったの
traducao: It is a fragment of Niata.\nI brought it back with me back then.

original: これにあった情報…、読んでいたのよ。\n聞きたい、かしら？
traducao: I was reading the data held within it...\nWould you like to hear?

original: じゃあ、あなたに話しておくわ
traducao: Well then, I shall tell you.

original: それは、聞く意志があると\n判断してもいいのかしら
traducao: May I take that as a sign\nof your willingness to listen?

original: どちらにしても、\nあなたは知っておいた方が良さそうだけど
traducao: Either way,\nyou really should know about this.

original: 欠片を読んでみたら、\nニアタの故郷のディセンダーの姿が見えたわ
traducao: Reading into the fragment, I caught\nsight of Niata's homeland Descender.

original: そのディセンダーが、カノンノにそっくりなの。\n信じられなかったわ
traducao: That Descender looked just like Kanonno.\nI could hardly believe it.

original: 名も…カノンノと言うらしいから
traducao: And her name... is also Kanonno, it seems.

original: でも、本当の事よ
traducao: Yet it is the truth.

original: 私も最初は、読んだ情報を疑ったわ
traducao: I doubted what I read at first too.

original: でも、何度読んでも同じだから、\n認めざるを得なかった
traducao: Yet no matter how often I read it,\nit was the same; I had to accept it.

original: 欠片からとても強く伝わってくる。\nパスカという異世界のディセンダー、\nカノンノを
traducao: It emanates strongly from the fragment.\nFeelings for the otherworld Descender,\nPasca Kanonno.

original: 共にずっと、\n故郷の世界を守り抜いていた固い絆
traducao: The unyielding bond they shared,\nprotecting their home world together.

original: ニアタは、ディセンダーを愛していたようよ
traducao: Niata truly loved that Descender.

original: 孫の様に、娘の様に、ね
traducao: Like a grandchild, like a daughter.

original: 偶然なのかしらね。\n私達の仲間のカノンノが、彼のディセンダーと、\nとても似たヒト、そして同じ名前だったのは…
traducao: Is it sheer coincidence?\nThat our companion Kanonno resembles his\nDescender so, and shares her name...?

original: 彼、言っていたわね。\n「この世界は、故郷パスカの情報因子を\n　受け継いでいない」って
traducao: He did mention it before, didn't he?\n'This world has not inherited the\ninformational factors of Pasca.'

original: でも、カノンノは存在するのよ。\nまるで世界の記憶が受け継がれていた様に、ね
traducao: Yet here Kanonno exists.\nAs though the world's memory lived on.

original: スケッチブックを忘れて、取りに来たの。\n見なかった？
traducao: I forgot my sketchbook and came back.\nHave you seen it?

original: さっき、ロックスが持って行ったわ
traducao: Rocks took it with him earlier.

original: ロックスが…。\nあちゃあ…、また片付けなかったって\n怒られちゃうなぁ
traducao: Rocks did...?\nOh dear... he'll scold me again\nfor not putting it away.

original: 欠片が…
traducao: The fragment is...

original: 今のは、なぁに…？
traducao: What was that just now...?

original: …いいえ、何でもないわ
traducao: ...No, it's nothing.

original: それじゃ、またね
traducao: Well then, see you later!

original: 頷く
traducao: Nod

original: 黙っている
traducao: Stay silent

original: 驚愕する
traducao: Look on in shock

original: 信じられない、と言う
traducao: Say you can't believe it
Waaaaugh!

original: 今のは、ロックスの声！？
traducao: Was that Rocks's voice?!

original: ○○。\n急いで食堂へ様子を見に行って！！
traducao: ○○.\nHurry to the dining hall and check!!

original: あわわわわわわわ……
traducao: A-Wawawawawa......

original: はっ…！？\nい、いらしてたんですか…
traducao: Huh...?!\nY-You were here...?

original: え、ええっ…！\nぼ、僕はそんなに大きな声を！？
traducao: Wh-What...?!\nD-Did I scream that loudly?!

original: す、すみません…
traducao: I-I am so sorry...

original: は、はい。\nすみません、取り乱してしまって…
traducao: Y-Yes.\nForgive me, I lost my composure...

original: 実は…、お嬢様のスケッチブックを片付けて\nここで絵を見ていたんです
traducao: Truth is... I was tidying Milady's\nsketchbook and looked at the drawings.

original: そのテーブルの上の絵ですが…
traducao: Regarding the drawing on that table...

original: お嬢様は知らないはずなんです。\n旦那様と奥様のお顔は…
traducao: Milady should have no memory of them.\nThe faces of the Master and Mistress...

original: なのに、お嬢様は……
traducao: And yet, Milady has......

original: まるで、今しがた見た様な正確さで\nお二人の姿を描いて…
traducao: Drawn their figures with such accuracy,\nas if seen just moments ago...

original: なぜ、お嬢様がこんな事を…
traducao: Why would Milady be able to do this...?

original: 風景の絵も、お嬢様の想像だと思っていました。\nお嬢様の豊かな才能だと、そう思いたかった…
traducao: I thought landscapes were her imagination.\nI wanted to believe it was her talent...

original: ですが、ヴェラトローパの絵や、既に絶滅\nしている植物の絵を描かれていた、と聞いて\n…確信したんです
traducao: Yet hearing she sketched Veratropa and\nplants that had already gone extinct...\n...I became certain.

original: お嬢様は…、何かを背負って生きている。\n僕には計り知れない何かを
traducao: Milady lives carrying a heavy burden...\nSomething far beyond my comprehension.

original: お嬢様…
traducao: Milady...

original: 悲鳴の原因を聞く
traducao: Ask what caused the scream

original: 大丈夫かと声をかける
traducao: Ask if he is all right

original: そう、そんな事があったの…。\nだから、ロックスは悲鳴をあげたのね
traducao: I see, so that's what happened...\nThat explains why Rocks screamed.

original: カノンノだけに見える風景、\n彼女にしかないドクメント…
traducao: Landscapes only Kanonno can see,\na Document unique to her alone...

original: カノンノには、\n何か隠された秘密があるのかしらね
traducao: Could Kanonno have some secret\nhidden within her, I wonder?

original: お話の途中、すみません。\n一つ、依頼があるのですが
traducao: Excuse me for interrupting,\nbut we have received a request.

original: はい、何でしょうか
traducao: Yes, what might it be?

original: ジルディアのキバについて、\n調査をしてみた方が良いと思いまして
traducao: I think it would be wise to launch\nan investigation into the Fang of Zirdia.

original: 既に各国のギルドに\n依頼が行っている様なのですが、\nどこも断っているそうなのです
traducao: Requests seem sent to guilds everywhere,\nyet it appears all of them\nhave turned it down.

original: あのキバについては\n調べておく必要があるなあ
traducao: We do need to investigate\nthat Fang, certainly.

original: よし！　それは私達がやりましょう！
traducao: All right! We shall take it on!

original: そうねぇ、誰が行ってくれるかしら…
traducao: Now then, who will go for us...?
